limits: Engineering Mathematics and General Aptitude cover the supplied solved GATE book plus ME papers for 2021–2026 and XE papers for 2007–2026 (aptitude starts in 2010).
ESE General Studies covers all 100 questions in each Paper I, 2017–2026. No earlier General Studies papers are claimed.
Official, publisher and independently solved answers are labelled separately. Seven source issues are retained without automatic scoring.
Scanned formulas and diagrams with uncertain OCR keep original printed choices instead of guessed text.
The two high-similarity duplicate candidates ask different questions; both were retained.
